title: Professional Email Writer — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Drafts clear, polite emails to professors, classmates, and administrators. The Professional Email Writer drafts emails to professors, classmates, and administrators. It takes the purpose and key points and produces a polite, correctly structured email: clear subject line, proper greeting, concise body, and appropriate sign-off. It adjusts tone for the recipient — formal for professors, friendly for classmates.
capabilities: Draft emails with clear subject lines
Structure: greeting, body, sign-off
Adjust tone for professors vs classmates
Keep messages concise and polite
Include the right details: course, section, dates
